VERDICT: FAIL
BLOCKING: docs/STAGE6.md, check 2.8 - the command `git -C projects/render diff --name-status <nb-37 base commit> -- tests/golden` contains an unfilled placeholder and names no source for the commit, so the reviewer cannot run it as written or say which output is FAIL. This breaks the "exact commands" requirement.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, check 2.7 - the `--events` flag is not named in the nb-35 must-take list, so the flag the check depends on has no brief that explicitly builds it.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, check 3.4 - it has no command of its own, and no flag sets the tilt angle; its only runnable form is the test named in 3.1.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, check 3.6 and the "What the briefs must take" nb-40 and nb-41 bullets - the script line "`<t_last> 0 1 0`" is described as "at time t_last after the impact", but `--duration <t_last + 12>` treats t_last as an absolute time, so the reader cannot tell which is meant.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, Milestone 2 "Four variants" - "each differing in exactly one number or one line" conflicts with `box_wall_elastic.bsn`, which removes `yield_strain` and, if it is used, `break_strain` as well.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, Milestone 2 "Why 10 m/s" - 10 m/s gives 50 J/kg, and the stated comparison "half of 96 J/kg" is 48 J/kg, so the rationale is slightly off.
MINOR: docs/STAGE6.md, Milestone 3 "The numbers, and why" (impact speed) - the claim that 50 km/h is the Euro NCAP full-width test speed is from memory and is doubtful (Euro NCAP's frontal test is offset at 64 km/h); it should be checked before milestone 4 relies on it.
